name: liquid-potassium
description: Domain-oriented TypeScript SDK and OpenClaw integration for the Infomaniak API.

scripts.ci: npm run check:generated && npm run check:no-network && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:coverage
scripts.check:generated: npm run normalize && npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- spec/infomaniak.normalized.json spec/normalization-report.json src/generated tests/generated
scripts.generate: tsx scripts/generate-types.ts && tsx scripts/generate-operations.ts && tsx scripts/generate-endpoint-tests.ts
